notes.title: Roadmap 2024
notes.content:
[b]Hi Commander,[/b]

today i want to give you a short overview of what will happen with TacTanks with the Roadmap 2024!

[b]- Server integration.[/b] Currently TacTanks is using a cloud server even for the single game. To give you the possibility to play offline the server logic must be integrated into the client. Also, the server logic for the coop play modes needs to be integrated in the client.

[b]- Achievements.[/b] Well, you need more rewards for your effort for a more exiting game experience!

[b]- Single Player Scenarios / Story[/b]. It is of course a lot more fun with a Story or with Scenarios. Currently I am working on the concept.

[b]- Additional Tanks[/b]

[b]- Additional Maps[/b]

So great things will happen before the release in 2024 will start! 

[b]Wishlist TacTanks to stay informed![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44279753/b1d1797b7bdd8965fc6e4d62e93e10f213963af7.png[/img]

notes.title: TacTanks Playtest 2.0
notes.content:
[b]Hello Commander,[/b]

I am pleased to invite you to the 2nd official playtest.

The feedback from the 1st playtest has been incorporated and more content has been added.
TacTanks is still under development, but it's already worth trying out. Your feedback is very important to improve the game. You can contact me at any time via the Discord server or the online form. You can find the links in the menu in TacTanks or on the Steam store page.

Thank you for your support and have fun trying out TacTanks!

notes.title: TacTanks Playtest Stream
notes.content:
Hello Commander,

just in time for playtest week we are testing TacTanks in coop mode with 4 players in the stream.
If you want to know how TacTanks plays and how you can play it with your friends, grab a coffee and watch us play.

notes.title: TacTanks - Playtest week
notes.content:
Hi Commander,

I am happy to invite you to the [b]1st official TacTanks Playtest Week[/b].
In the period from 28.09. to 08.10. you can try TacTank for free.

TacTanks is currently still under development and new content and functions are added daily. 
In this test you can already select from 4 different tank models and test initial equipment.

The version published here was already tested by me for many hours, however, it is not improbable that errors occur in the game.

Your feedback is really important in this playtest!

You can find the link to the Discord server in the menu. Use this to become part of a new community and to get directly in contact with me.
There you can also report errors and add suggestions.
Furthermore you will find a link to an online questionnaire in the menu where you can provide feedback on TacTanks anonymously.

Thank you very much for your support and have fun with trying TacTanks!
